caption.zh: 原理图。沿 U201A 的 3 脚向右读，输出经 270 Ω 电阻 R202 接到发光二极管 LED201。
caption.en: Schematic. Follow pin 3 of U201A through the 270 Ω resistor R202 to the light-emitting diode LED201.

alt.zh: ColdFire 原理图局部，U201 的四路缓冲器分别经电阻接到四只 LED。
alt.en: Four buffer outputs on a ColdFire schematic, each connected to an LED through a resistor.

caption.zh: 板图。三个接口沿上边缘排列。焊盘给出了接线的位置，各层的铜线绕开器件，把焊盘连起来。
caption.en: Board layout. Three connectors sit along the top edge. Tracks on different layers connect the pads.

alt.zh: ColdFire 板图，能看到板边接口、两组密集焊盘和多层走线。
alt.en: ColdFire board layout with edge connectors, groups of fine-pitch pads, and tracks on several layers.

caption.zh: KiCad 从电池座一侧观察这块 LED 板。黑色电池座和红色 LED 分装在两面。核对外壳时，两面都要留出器件的高度。
caption.en: The 3D view looks toward the battery holder. The holder and the red LED sit on opposite sides. Check enclosure clearance on both sides.

alt.zh: KiCad 三维查看器中的 LED 板，黑色电池座朝上，红色 LED 从另一面伸出。
alt.en: KiCad 3D view of an LED board with a battery holder facing up and a red LED below the board.

caption.zh: 沿右侧 VCC 焊盘往下看。蓝线在底层，经过圆形过孔后，红线在顶层接到 R1 的 1 号焊盘。
caption.en: Follow VCC from the pad on the right. The blue track runs on the bottom layer. At the via, the red track continues on the top layer to pad 1 of R1.

alt.zh: LED 板布线图，右侧一段蓝色走线通过过孔连接红色走线，下方的红线连接电阻和 LED。
alt.en: LED board with blue and red tracks joined at a via on the right. A red track connects the resistor to the LED.

caption.zh: 教程移动了 R1，保留旧的铺铜结果。第一条错误显示，VCC 焊盘到 GND 铜区的间距要求为 0.5000 mm，实际为 0.0000 mm。重新填充铜区后再跑 DRC，六项错误全部消除。
caption.en: The tutorial moves R1 and keeps the previous copper fill. The first error shows zero clearance from VCC to GND, against a 0.5000 mm rule. Refilling the zone and running DRC again clears all six errors.

alt.zh: KiCad 设计规则检查窗口，显示六项错误，第一项列出 R1 的 VCC 焊盘及 B.Cu 层的 GND 铜区。
alt.en: KiCad reports six design rule errors. The first identifies the VCC pad of R1 and the GND zone on the bottom copper layer.
